items.title: Stack
items.description: Flex column or row with gap from spacing tokens. Polymorphic `as`.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Layout primitive for YoRHa-styled screens; gaps are fixed at 16px (4 x --spacing) in every density (B1): [data-density] scales controls, rows and body text, not layout gaps. Migration (v3): before v3 gaps followed [data-density]; to keep that, add gap-pad-* yourself.
